test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Eight boys Virat, Rohit, Kamal, Lakshmana, Rahul, Ram, Ramesh and Sohan are sitting around a circular table facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order). Rahul is second to the left of Kamal. Kamal is third to the left of Virat. Lakshmana is second to the right of Ram. Rohit is second to the right of Kamal. Ramesh is not an immediate neighbor of Kamal. Virat is second to the left of Ram. Who is second to the right of Sohan?
solution:
Eight boys** Virat, Rohit, Kamal, Lakshmana****, Rahul, Ram, Ramesh and Sohan** are sitting around a circular table facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order).

1. Rahul is second to the left of Kamal.

2. Kamal is third to the left of Virat.

3. Rohit is second to the right of Kamal.

4. Ramesh is not an immediate neighbor of Kamal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cdb6b3ff65ade3d94fd15f9f9410baa6b25a693cea92936c09ad1dcc72ac939.png] 

5. Virat is second to the left of Ram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ae4039cbdc27acdd8db9bee33c444705a0caa7547dd98461c3565996e4c79a8.png] 

6. Lakshmana is second to the right of Ram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f044018512d8771050940fc87d31e62413755de17022d7023a68503b5848b4e3.png] 

Ramesh is sitting between Ram and Virat.

Sohan is sitting between Rohit and Kamal.

The final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/525f11817acbbb0011b5b87e5fe66d65705a08d2684dc2f66a45550db5b49e31.png] 

Clearly, Virat is sitting second to the right of Sohan.

Hence, '**Virat**' is the correct answer.
